key_highlights: ASX staged an $80B relief rally following US midterm elections, closing the week higher despite intraday volatility.
Department store icon David Jones collapsed into voluntary administration, triggering distress across discretionary retail, suppliers, and commercial landlords.
Banking sector faced headwinds as NAB dived, while data centre operator NextDC rallied strongly on structural tech demand.
Qantas flagged a $1B fuel cost headwind, prompting capacity cuts and fare hikes that test consumer resilience.
RBA reiterated hawkish stance on persistent excess demand and sticky inflation, intensifying household and mortgage stress.

sectors.trend: Severe structural deterioration culminating in David Jones entering voluntary administration and shuttering stores.
sectors.implications: Heightened counterparty and vacancy risks for shopping centre REITs alongside working capital hits for unsecured suppliers.

sectors.trend: Outperformance led by cloud infrastructure and data centre providers post-US midterms.
sectors.implications: Strong institutional appetite for defensive digital infrastructure plays, highlighted by NextDC's sharp rally.

sectors.trend: Divergence and margin pressure amid rising macro headwinds and bad debt scrutiny.
sectors.implications: NAB's sharp pullback underscores growing credit risk and housing market headwinds as higher rates curb loan growth.

sectors.trend: Input cost inflation from elevated aviation fuel weighing on carrier operating margins.
sectors.implications: Qantas facing margin compression, requiring aggressive yield management and capacity cuts that may dent volumes.

sectors.trend: Robust capital raising activity in precious metals alongside ongoing junior exploration in gold and lithium.
sectors.implications: Institutional funding remains resilient for high-quality gold producers, while junior exploration remains active.

key_themes: US political de-risking post-midterms providing broad equity market valuation relief.
Domestic consumer exhaustion exposed by marquee retail insolvency and sticky RBA interest rate projections.
Diverging sectoral resilience between asset-backed digital infrastructure and discretionary retail/housing exposures.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight retail REITs and exposed apparel distributors; prioritize nondiscretionary real estate and essential retail.
Hedge rate-sensitive duration risk; maintain allocations to high-cash-flow resources and floating-rate instruments.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Liquidity Crunch & Price Correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Trim exposure to domestic-focused mortgage lenders and residential developers with elevated balance sheet gearing.
Limit exposure to airline carriers lacking adequate fuel hedging buffers; favor transport assets with pass-through pricing power.

opportunities.rationale: Structural AI and cloud adoption insulate data centre operators from domestic consumer discretionary weakness.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on Gold Equity Recapitalisation Momentum
opportunities.rationale: Strong institutional broker appetite and elevated bullion pricing support earnings growth among active producers.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to Discretionary Retail Landlords & Suppliers
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones administration threatens tenancy cash flows, lease renewals, and unsecured trade receivables.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Major Bank Exposures Against Housing & Credit Downturn
defensive_moves.rationale: Diminished borrowing capacity and prospective rising arrears threaten major bank net interest margins and credit provisions.

market_outlook.short_term: Cautiously constructive near-term ASX trajectory supported by global post-election relief, tempered by domestic retail and banking drags.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued medium-term growth as elevated RBA cash rates, housing price softness, and household budget pressures constrain broader domestic earnings.
key_catalysts: RBA upcoming monetary policy decision and updated inflation statement
Supplier and creditor resolution outcomes from the David Jones administration
Global crude oil trajectory and airline operating cost updates
Post-US midterm legislative shifts and global AI infrastructure spending
watch_list: Australian quarterly CPI and Wage Price Index
National dwelling price indices and mortgage delinquency rates
Retail sales figures heading into Christmas trading
AUD/USD exchange rate volatility and commodity price shifts
